Shot: Rear three-quarter hero view.
Camera is 35 degrees from the rear-right corner, camera height 0.9m, lens look around 70mm, level horizon, full vehicle visible. Rear lights, trunk/tailgate shape, bumper, exhaust area, and one full side must match the reference images exactly.

Shot: Perfect side profile.
Camera is exactly perpendicular to the vehicle side, camera height 1.0m, lens look around 85mm to avoid distortion, level horizon. The car is centered, all wheels aligned, full side silhouette visible, clean catalog composition.

Shot: Straight-on front view.
Camera is centered on the vehicle front, symmetrical composition, camera height 0.95m, lens look around 70mm. The grille, headlights, hood line, front bumper, mirrors, and windshield shape must match the reference images exactly.

Shot: Front detail close-up.
Close-up professional detail photo of the front headlight, grille, hood edge, and bumper corner. Use shallow depth of field, realistic paint reflections, crisp materials. Preserve the exact headlight and grille design from the reference images.

Shot: Rear taillight and trunk detail.
Create a professional close-up automotive detail photo of the exact vehicle's rear taillight, trunk or tailgate edge, rear bumper corner, and visible trim area. Use a 90mm detail photography look, camera height around 0.8m, shallow realistic depth of field, clean studio reflections, crisp taillight lens texture.

Preserve the exact taillight shape, rear body panel lines, bumper geometry, paint color, trim pieces, exhaust area if visible, and all visible condition marks from the rear reference image. Do not invent trim badges, random model text, fake dealer logos, different taillights, or a different bumper design.

Shot: Wheel and tire detail.
Create a professional close-up photo of the exact vehicle's front wheel, tire, lower door panel, and side skirt. Camera height around 0.35m, lens look around 85mm, three-quarter side angle, sharp focus on the wheel and tire, realistic rubber texture, realistic brake shadow, clean studio floor reflection.

Preserve the exact wheel rim design, spoke count, wheel color, tire size impression, body paint color, lower body panel shape, and any visible curb rash or damage from the reference images. Do not change the rim style, add oversized wheels, distort the tire into an oval, or hide condition-relevant wheel damage.

Shot: Low-angle premium front three-quarter.
Camera is 0.45m high, 30 degrees from the front, controlled wide automotive perspective without distortion. Stronger rim light, dramatic but realistic showroom reflections, full vehicle visible, powerful stance.

Shot: Front three-quarter hero view.
Camera is 35 degrees from the front-left corner of the vehicle, camera height 0.85m, lens look around 70mm, level horizon, medium distance, full vehicle in frame with a little breathing room. Front grille and one full side are visible. Wheels turned very slightly outward for a premium catalog look.

Shot: Front headlight and grille detail.
Create a professional close-up automotive detail photo of the exact vehicle's front headlight, grille edge, hood line, and front bumper corner. Use a 90mm macro-style lens look, camera height around 0.75m, shallow but believable depth of field, crisp headlight lens texture, clean paint reflections, and soft studio lighting.

Preserve the exact headlight shape, grille pattern, paint color, bumper lines, trim pieces, and any visible condition marks from the reference images. Do not invent a different headlight design, fake badge, extra vents, random text, or unreadable plate characters.

Use Image 1 as the front-side reference photo and Image 2 as the rear-side reference photo of the same exact vehicle.

Create one professional automotive showroom photograph of this exact vehicle.

Vehicle identity lock:
Preserve the exact vehicle body shape, paint color, grille, headlights, taillights, wheel design, tire size, mirror shape, roofline, window shape, trim, badges, door count, proportions, and visible exterior details from the reference images.
Do not turn it into a different model, different trim, different year, different color, or different wheel design.

Realistic vehicle presentation:
Make the vehicle look clean, natural, and professionally photographed.
Preserve the vehicle's real visible exterior appearance and original details.
Do not change the vehicle's actual body structure, parts, color, wheels, lights, trim, or proportions.
Only improve the photography environment, lighting, background cleanliness, and visual presentation.

Scene:
Premium automotive photography in a controlled showroom or studio environment.
Clean floor, realistic contact shadows, believable reflections, no clutter.

Lighting:
Large softbox reflections along the body panels, soft overhead fill light, subtle rim light, natural glossy paint reflections, realistic glass and tire materials.

Output:
Single vehicle only, full car visible unless this is a detail shot.
Photorealistic, professional dealership catalog photography, sharp focus, realistic proportions.

Privacy and safety constraints:
No people, no faces, no readable license plate, no phone number, no QR code, no storefront text, no watermark, no added text, no fake dealer logo, no random letters or numbers.
If a license plate is visible, replace it with a clean blank dealer plate with no readable characters.

Image constraints:
No collage, no split screen, no extra cars, no distorted wheels, no melted body panels, no unrealistic reflections, no invented vehicle features.

Background preset A: bright luxury studio, seamless light gray cyclorama wall, satin concrete floor, clean soft shadows, high-end dealership catalog look.
